title: Mute flip stops only crisis+arrival sounds — the new wire/spawn sounds keep playing
detail: The diff adds two PlaySound families but the pre-existing mute-stop path wasn't extended. Muting (M key, main.odin:734) mid-chime leaves the spawn chime (0.66 s placeholder) and wire tock ringing past the flip — the 'flip immediate' contract above toggle_mute.
recommended_fix: In toggle_mute's muted branch add: for s in a.wire { rl.StopSound(s) } and for s in a.spawn { rl.StopSound(s) }.

title: Spawn placeholder synthesizes 0.66 s sequential tones — outside its own documented 0.2–0.4 s envelope
evidence:
case .Spawn:
		// the soft chime — Brush's spawn recipe: low thump + mid body + high
		// tick, layered over ~0.3 s with a gentle tail (announces, never
		// alarms; growth cadence is 4 s, so it never stacks).
		thumps := SPAWN_THUMP
		bodies := SPAWN_BODY
		ticks := SPAWN_TICK
		slot := idx % SPAWN_VARIANTS
		tone_append(&out, thumps[slot], 0.22, 0.5)
		tone_append(&out, bodies[slot], 0.30, 0.35)
		tone_append(&out, ticks[slot], 0.14, 0.28)
--- vs assets/audio/README.md:38 ---
- **Spawn chimes:** 0.2–0.4 s, SOFT (they announce, never alarm) — the
detail: tone_append appends sequentially, so the layers are back-to-back: 0.22+0.30+0.14 = 0.66 s — 65% past the README's max and not 'layered over ~0.3 s'. The asset-less default every player hears violates the slot contract the same diff ships.
recommended_fix: Mix the three layers into one ~0.3 s buffer (offset writes), or correct the README/comment envelope to 0.66 s.
